text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned increasing pain and swelling in your left knee for the past two months; to help me understand the cause, have you noticed any trauma, fever, or redness in that area?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient reports increasing pain and swelling of the left knee over 2 months. Describes the pain as severe enough to awaken him from sleep on several occasions. States he tried taking ibuprofen with no relief. No family or personal history of significant illnesses.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteosarcoma of the left knee.
The severe pain awakening you from sleep and the lack of relief with ibuprofen are highly concerning for a malignancy. I need to see an MRI of your left knee and request a biopsy immediately to confirm the diagnosis and stage the tumor.
